area_note: Central and South Jakarta, mainly the Senayan (GBK) and Sudirman–SCBD areas
intro: Jakarta's club runs centre on the Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) sports complex in Senayan and the nearby Sudirman–SCBD business district. Weekday groups meet either early in the morning or after work in the evening. On Sunday mornings, Car Free Day closes Jalan Sudirman to traffic, and community fun runs there start as early as 5:30am. Most local groups announce their sessions on Instagram rather than on websites.

clubs.name: Indo Runners
clubs.description: An independent running community founded in Jakarta in 2009. XSports Medal's 2026 round-up reported tens of thousands of members and more than 100,000 social-media followers. Its regular fixture is the Sunday AM Run.
clubs.active_evidence: XSports Medal round-up of active Jakarta running communities, 27 Mar 2026

clubs.name: IR Runiversity

meets.where: Ministry of Youth and Sports (Kemenpora) office
With Indo Runners, Ashta District 8, SCBD

clubs.who: Runners who want to learn technique
clubs.description: Part of the Indo Runners community. It focuses on teaching running technique and development, and adds weekly strength training to the Sunday run.

clubs.name: Jakbrunners (Jakarta Barat Runners)
clubs.description: Founded in May 2014 under the hashtag #YourRunningBuddies. The group also holds non-running social activities for members.

clubs.name: Skolari
clubs.who: Open to the public; beginners and experienced runners
clubs.description: A free community set up in January 2019 by runners who wanted a group with no barriers or exclusivity.

clubs.name: Thunder Light Jakarta

meets.when: Wednesdays 7pm (Wednesday Session: themed workouts such as strength, fartlek or hills)

clubs.who: Open to everyone; no requirements to join
clubs.description: A fun-running crew formed in February 2020 by friends who ran together at night. It supports members training for half and full marathons and runs a cheering zone at races. Refreshments are provided at sessions.
clubs.active_evidence: XSports Medal round-up, 27 Mar 2026 (schedule detail from JadwalLari profile, Oct 2025)

clubs.name: adidas Runners Jakarta
clubs.description: The adidas brand running community in Jakarta. With Maybank Marathon it ran the public Road to Maybank Marathon 2026 training programme from 3 May to 16 August 2026, which included coaching clinics, long runs, strength, hill and heat-adaptation training.
clubs.active_evidence: IDN Times report on the Road to Maybank Marathon 2026 programme, 30 Apr 2026

clubs.name: teman kumparan Running Club

meets.when: Periodic Sunday fun runs, 5:30am (dates announced by kumparan)

clubs.who: All levels, from new joggers to regular runners; relaxed pace
clubs.description: The reader community running club of the news site kumparan. Its Car Free Day fun runs have club captains and pacers, and include free refreshments. Runners join through the club's group link (kum.pr/running).
clubs.active_evidence: Fun runs on 25 Jan 2026 and 26 Apr 2026 (kumparan, 23 Apr 2026)
